race.comment: SWIFT RULER (4) closed nicely last start but couldn't bring up four wins in a row when 0.5L off Roger in Open 3YO company. The rise in trip is no issue on what we've seen recently and he looks a very untapped commodity. Drops in weight coming into this and if he can take closer order, he can go one better. I LOVE YA MONEY (8) got back to winning ways last start when scoring over the mile by 1.6L. He sat handy and got the job done there from a wide draw and now draws the inside out in trip. He's another progressive type who can bring up back-to-back wins. I DREAMED A DREAM (3) bolted in off a freshen last start at Kalgoorlie, racing over the mile and winning by 4.2L. Raced well at this track and trip previously and has to be included on his latest effort. WILD THINGS (6) is up in grade today but her recent form makes for good reading. KING OF THE TOWN (9) can feature third-up into the campaign.
